notes:
What's new in 1.6.1:
- Finds Fusion transactions that fail inside VTA before an O Series request is created by searching Oracle inbound TrxNumber and TrxId values as Document Number and Fusion Transaction Id.
- Classifies inbound-only results as Supplies or Procurement from the Oracle application and labels them clearly as Oracle Inbound activity.
- Extracts Oracle error codes and messages, adds a line-numbered Error Stack viewer, and hides O Series-only preview tabs when no O Series calculation occurred.
